key_insight: A recovery-based C⁰ linear finite element method approximates a fourth-order perturbed PDE used to compute viscosity solutions of the fully nonlinear Monge–Ampère equation.
engineering_relevance: The approach offers a mathematically supported discretization strategy for nonlinear PDE computation using low-order finite elements, rather than an AI surrogate.
method: Use a recovery operator to construct a C⁰ linear finite element discretization.
Establish well-posedness with a Miranda–Talenti-type estimate and H² convergence through a fixed-point argument.
Derive optimal H¹-error estimates using a duality argument.
evidence_signal: Numerical experiments support the method’s efficiency and theoretical convergence results, though the abstract reports no quantitative benchmarks.
watch_item: Convergence is established for the perturbed model; the abstract does not specify how perturbation choices affect accuracy relative to the original Monge–Ampère equation.
paper_title: A recovery based linear finite element method for the Monge--Ampère equation
